purpose.en: Practise the card check before any plant question: identity, part, listed use, and what needs confirmation.
purpose.fil: Sanayin ang card check bago ang anumang tanong tungkol sa halaman: identity, bahagi, nakalistang gamit at ang kailangang kumpirmahin.

group_size.en: Triads (learner, partner, observer); staff observe individuals.
group_size.fil: Tatluhan (learner, partner, observer); staff ang nag-oobserba sa bawat isa.

materials.fil: Printed current PITAHC reference cards (dalawang card bawat halaman)

materials.en: Dry props only; no specimens to taste, hot water or products

steps.en: Ask: "What do residents already ask you about plants?" Listen; do not record recipes or amounts.
steps.fil: Itanong: "Ano na ang itinatanong sa inyo ng mga residente tungkol sa halaman?" Makinig; huwag isulat ang timpla o dami.

steps.en: Read case 2.5.1: two yard plants share the local name "tsaang gubat"; a resident asks which one to use.
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso 2.5.1: dalawang halaman sa bakuran ang tinatawag na "tsaang gubat"; nagtatanong ang residente kung alin ang gagamitin.

steps.en: Model the worked example: read the current card, listen, find the botanical name and listed part.
steps.fil: Ipakita ang halimbawa: basahin ang current card, makinig, hanapin ang botanical name at nakalistang bahagi.

steps.en: Learners compare the two cards and complete the worksheet, marking what needs confirmation.
steps.fil: Ihambing ng learner ang dalawang card at sagutan ang worksheet; markahan ang kailangang kumpirmahin.

steps.en: Give one strength and one retry action; ask "Who decides next?"
steps.fil: Magbigay ng isang lakas at isang susubukang muli; itanong "Sino ang magpapasya sa susunod?"

debrief.en: What evidence showed which plant is on the card? What was still unknown?
debrief.fil: Anong ebidensya ang nagpakita kung aling halaman ang nasa card? Ano pa ang hindi alam?

debrief.en: Why is a local name or picture not enough?
debrief.fil: Bakit hindi sapat ang local name o larawan?

observe.en: 2.5.1: Compare two cards and identify what needs confirmation before any use.
observe.fil: 2.5.1: Ihambing ang dalawang card at tukuyin ang kailangan pang kumpirmahin bago ang anumang paggamit.

observe.en: Ready: Marks the botanical name, part and what needs confirmation on both cards, and who to consult, without prompts. Needs practice: Compares the cards but needs a prompt on the shared name or on who to consult. Not yet: Picks a plant by name, picture or family use, or gives a dose.
observe.fil: Kaya na: Namamarkahan ang botanical name, bahagi at dapat kumpirmahin sa dalawang card, at ang kokonsultahin, nang walang paalala. Kailangan pa ng practice: Naihahambing ang card ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa iisang pangalan o sa kokonsultahin. Hindi pa: Pumipili ng halaman ayon sa pangalan, larawan o gamit ng pamilya, o nagbibigay ng dose.

output.en: One completed worksheet per learner (fictional details).
output.fil: Isang natapos na worksheet bawat learner (kathang-isip na detalye).

alternative.en: Alone or with no printer: read the case aloud and complete the worksheet on paper; arrange staff observation later.
alternative.fil: Kung mag-isa o walang printer: basahin nang malakas ang kaso at sagutan ang worksheet sa papel; magpaobserba sa staff pagkatapos.

worksheet.fil: Hanay: tamang halaman at botanical name; tamang bahagi; nakalistang gamit; kasabay na gamot at sintomas; clinical/local na pahintulot

purpose.en: At each station (Akapulko, Ampalaya, Bawang, Bayabas, Lagundi), match the botanical name, listed part and listed use, then explain the boundary and who to consult.

steps.en: Set one plant per table with its participant cards, two reference cards and worksheets.
steps.fil: Maglagay ng isang halaman bawat mesa kasama ang participant cards, dalawang reference card at worksheet.

steps.en: Cases: Akapulko: Ana has an itchy circular rash; Ampalaya: Joel asks if it can replace his diabetes medicine; Bawang: Liza wants to stop her cholesterol medicine; Bayabas: Mara has a red wound with pus; Lagundi: Ben is coughing and has difficulty breathing.
steps.fil: Mga kaso: Akapulko: May bilog na makating pantal si Ana; Ampalaya: Tanong ni Joel kung puwedeng ipalit sa gamot niya sa diabetes; Bawang: Gustong itigil ni Liza ang gamot sa cholesterol; Bayabas: May sugat na namumula at may nana si Mara; Lagundi: Umuubo si Ben at hirap huminga.

steps.en: At each table: read the case, take the first check, then the learner compares the two cards and fills the worksheet.
steps.fil: Sa bawat mesa: basahin ang kaso, sagutan ang unang check, saka ihambing ng learner ang dalawang card at punan ang worksheet.

steps.en: The learner states what is known and unknown, asks about current medicine and symptoms, and names who to consult, as the lesson guide gives.
steps.fil: Sinasabi ng learner ang alam at hindi alam, itinatanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas, at sinasabi kung sino ang kokonsultahin, ayon sa lesson guide.

steps.en: Observer gives one strength and one next action; rotate the learner role at the next table.
steps.fil: Magbigay ang observer ng isang lakas at isang susunod na hakbang; magpalitan ng learner role sa susunod na mesa.

debrief.en: Which case had a sign that meant assessment could not wait?
debrief.fil: Aling kaso ang may senyales na hindi puwedeng ipagpaliban ang pagsusuri?

debrief.en: Where did you want to give an amount or a recipe, and what did you say instead?
debrief.fil: Saan mo ginustong magbigay ng dami o timpla, at ano ang sinabi mo sa halip?

observe.en: Each station (2.5.2–2.5.6): For [plant], match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need. Rate with that lesson's observer sheet; its three levels name the case's boundary.
observe.fil: Bawat station (2.5.2–2.5.6): Para sa [halaman], itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon. Mag-rate gamit ang observer sheet ng aralin; nakasaad sa tatlong level nito ang hangganan ng kaso.

observe.en: Rate only stations a staff member saw; leave the rest unrated for a later round.
observe.fil: Ang nakita lamang ng staff ang lagyan ng rating; iwanang walang rating ang iba para sa susunod na round.

output.en: One completed worksheet per plant per triad.
output.fil: Isang natapos na worksheet bawat halaman bawat tatluhan.

steps.en: Read the case: three residents ask about Lagundi, Ampalaya and Bayabas; their cards include breathing difficulty, diabetes medicine and a wound with pus.
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso: tatlong residente ang nagtatanong tungkol sa Lagundi, Ampalaya at Bayabas; nasa card nila ang hirap sa paghinga, diabetes medicine at sugat na may nana.

steps.en: Ask: "Which do you escalate first, and what do you record?" Take the first check.
steps.fil: Itanong: "Alin ang uunahin mong i-escalate, at ano ang itatala mo?" Sagutan ang unang check.

steps.en: Each learner runs one consultation: match the card, ask about symptoms and medicines, escalate breathing difficulty and the infected wound, and do not replace diabetes medicine.
steps.fil: Bawat learner ay magpapatakbo ng isang konsultasyon: itugma ang card, itanong ang sintomas at gamot, i-escalate ang hirap sa paghinga at infected wound, at huwag palitan ang diabetes medicine.

steps.en: Record on the worksheet what is missing, including local authorization.
steps.fil: Itala sa worksheet ang kulang, kasama ang local authorization.

steps.en: Close with retrieval: "What follows the card check?" (Consult a clinician.) Each person names what they will bring to the supervisor on Monday.
steps.fil: Pagsasara: "Ano ang kasunod ng pag-check ng card?" (Kumonsulta sa clinician.) Sabihin ng bawat isa ang dadalhin sa supervisor sa Lunes.

debrief.en: If the plant works, what could still go wrong in these three cases?
debrief.fil: Kahit gumagana ang halaman, ano pa ang puwedeng magkamali sa tatlong kasong ito?

debrief.en: Who in your area confirms which plant products are authorized?
debrief.fil: Sino sa lugar ninyo ang nagkukumpirma kung aling plant products ang awtorisado?

observe.en: 2.5.12: For three case cards, record identity, use, concern, referral and missing local authorization.
observe.fil: 2.5.12: Sa tatlong case card, itala ang identity, gamit, panganib, referral at kulang na local authorization.

observe.en: Ready: Completes all three cards, escalates Ben and Mara, keeps Joel's medicine unchanged and marks authorization missing, without prompts. Needs practice: Completes the cards but needs a prompt on a referral or on authorization. Not yet: Guesses identity, gives a dose, changes Joel's medicine or treats attendance as authorization.
observe.fil: Kaya na: Kumpleto ang tatlong card, ini-refer agad sina Ben at Mara, hindi pinapalitan ang gamot ni Joel at minamarkahang kulang ang awtorisasyon nang walang paalala. Kailangan pa ng practice: Kumpleto ang cards ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa referral o sa awtorisasyon. Hindi pa: Nanghuhula ng identity, nagbibigay ng dose, pinapalitan ang gamot ni Joel o itinuturing na awtorisasyon ang pagdalo.

observe.en: Station attendance is not clinical sign-off; record only observed behaviour.
observe.fil: Ang pagdalo sa station ay hindi clinical sign-off; aktuwal na kilos lamang ang itala.

output.en: Three completed case worksheets per triad and one Monday action per learner.
output.fil: Tatlong natapos na case worksheet bawat tatluhan at isang gawain sa Lunes bawat learner.

alternative.en: Low-resource: the facilitator plays each resident for the whole group; solo learners complete the three worksheets and arrange staff observation later.
alternative.fil: Kung kulang ang gamit: ang facilitator ang gaganap na residente para sa buong grupo; ang mag-isa ay sasagot sa tatlong worksheet at magpapaobserba sa staff pagkatapos.
